column1: # ergon-io bypass matrix. Pair a, two hosts. Loss is the kernel peer (host b):
# egress netem and ifb ingress, including on the bypass arms. Host a's DPDK
# NIC has no qdisc. Minimum RTO is TR_TCP_RTO_MIN_US (8 ms) on every arm.
# No 32 or 128 streams, no 200k msg/s, no F-Stack UDP.
arm io-tcp-epoll  wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend epoll-spin --echo tcp
arm io-tcp-smol   wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend smoltcp-spin --echo tcp
arm io-tcp-fstack fstack_spin_lat sockets two --impl ergon
arm io-ws-epoll   wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend epoll-spin --echo wstls
arm io-ws-smol    wstls_lat  sockets two --impl ergon --backend smoltcp-spin --echo wstls
arm io-ws-fstack  wstls_fstack_lat sockets two --impl ergon --backend fstack-spin --echo wstls
arm io-udp-epoll  udp_lat    sockets two --impl ergon --backend epoll-spin
arm io-udp-smol   udp_lat    sockets two --impl ergon --backend smoltcp-spin
